title: falcaria longiloba
intro: Falcaria longiloba, commonly known as Wild Oyster Fern, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Falcaria longiloba include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include falcarinol, a sesquiterpene lactone with potential anti-cancer properties, and other compounds with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
